limits: Nominal source geometry, trial fastening and straight-shank access only. Complete mated connectors, thread fits, hand access, thermal performance and rear-switch operability remain unqualified.
additional_assembly: With pitch head and shells detached, bench-fit fixed reaction link/horn/clamp through the combined yaw U/journal. Insert this group into bearing/bridge, then fit reaction cross-retainer, yaw servo/output and lock. Removal reverses this sequence; reaction link travels with U/journal after cross-retainer removal. In operation the reaction link remains BODY-fixed, never yaw-parented. M1.14: install6 flange screws per motor on bench before bearings; slide bearings/spacers onto shaft; insert whole cartridges from below; fit common cap with4 M3 bolts; install load frame, shell, then D hubs and end washers/M3 screws. Release wheel end bolts before cap/cartridge removal.

Wheel_Cap_L/R deleted; hub outer faces exposed
power_board_assembly: Received populated native power board at1:1 on existing four seats, two diagonal M2x6; mating connectors and thermal behavior remain unqualified.
retained_service_splits: Yaw_Base vs Load_Frame: bearing and reaction-link installation

microphones: M1.19: no printed ducts or added fasteners. Keep the CAM onboard microphones, open rear-frame passages and shell sound holes; recording performance remains untested.
head_cleanup: Uniform4.5mm folded U with broad diagonal rear walls, square optical returns and16mm constant-width mast. Bench-fit four nuts atx+/-39.2 before lateral face screws; original three LCD post datums and camera tilt retained. CAM permanent fastening awaits actual board dimensions.

native_electronics: V1.2-H0.5-P5R7 handoff; actual per-board source revisions recorded in native_electronics_geometry.json; four nominal1.6mm boards, source-backed or generic package data
buck_assembly: Remove battery/tray for bottom access. Fit units before main frame final assembly; disconnect leads. Thermal separation unqualified.
head_servo_installation: Fit trial M2 inserts to four plain seats. With optical/pitch head and yaw servo absent, seat and fix the180deg-clocked pitch case through both real ears. Fit the yaw servo with output down, then its two ear screws. Load is carried by bilateral pitch bearings and yaw bearing. Horn engagement/zero, insert fits and torque require real units.
